messages:
nina_sales: Heads-up: Lee at Acme hitting 403 on /v1/generate during demo. Says project claim mismatch. Can infra look?

lee_acme: "403 Forbidden: project claim does not match request" when calling /v1/generate. Using key from portal.

nina_sales: can you paste the curl (hide the key)?

lee_acme: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer sk.test.ABC" -H "X-Redwood-Project: acme-demo" -d '{"model":"redwood-small","input":"test"}'

jess_se: quick note: project header must exactly match the project bound to the API key. Trial keys sometimes bind to a different internal project name.

ravi_infra: logs show: bound_project=acme-trial header_project=acme-demo decision=DENY (project mismatch).

lee_acme: if I change header to acme-trial does it work?

tom_support: please try: curl ... -H "X-Redwood-Project: acme-trial"

lee_acme: switched header to acme-trial and get 200. Ok.

nina_sales: customer wants minimal changes to their code. Can infra rebind the key to acme-demo? Also saw intermittent 429s during load demo.

ravi_infra: can rebind or issue a new key. Rebinding done if you approve. 429s are from free-tier throttle (60rpm) - their demo spiked to ~120rpm. We can do a temporary uplift for the demo.

ops_bot: Rebind action recorded: act_4501 by ravi_infra at 2024-11-12T18:10:05Z. Quota uplift to 250rpm applied until 2024-11-12T20:00:00Z.

nina_sales: Lee please confirm after rebind. I'll follow up with a short pricing ballpark for sustained 10 qps.

lee_acme: confirmed calls work with acme-demo header. Thanks all!
